$comment: Iceberg School facts shown on the public site. Leave a value empty until it is confirmed: the page then hides or rewords that part (owner decision 2026-10-25: no visible [placeholders]) and leaves it out of search data. Never guess. Stage grades follow the standard Uzbek school structure (1–4, 5–9, 10–11); change them if the school differs. Text values are Uzbek; their Russian and English live in translations/ru.json and translations/en.json (keyed by the Uzbek text).
name: Iceberg School

leader.name: Azizbek Nasriddinov
leader.message: Iceberg School'da har bir bolani ismi bilan taniymiz va uning kuchli tomonlarini birga kashf etamiz. Ko'rinib turgan natijalar — baholar va sertifikatlar — chuqur bilim, yaxshi odatlar va mustahkam xarakterdan o'sib chiqadi. Maktabimizga xush kelibsiz: farzandingiz kelajagining poydevorini birga quramiz.
leader.message_note: Drafted for the owner on request (2026-10-25); Azizbek to approve the wording.
